name: visual-metaphor-slides
description: HTML/SVG presentation plugin featuring 20 non-rectangular visual structural metaphor slide layouts across 5 geometric families: Hub & Radial, Trajectory & Momentum, Organic & Flow, Synergy & Network, and Depth & Perspective, plus a full 16:9 interactive HTML deck engine.
author: David Alzate (@futix13)

commands.description: Create an interactive 16:9 HTML presentation using the 20 Visual Structural Metaphors (e.g. /metaphor-deck AI Platform Strategy)
